title: Generic Wood Crafting from Chorus Fruit
description: Allows basic wood crafting from Chorus Fruit.
body:
Allows chorus fruit and byproducts to be used in place of generic woods. This is primarily intended for custom starting locations such as End Biome Skyblock islands as it allows basic things to be crafted without access to trees.
- 2 Chorus Fruit can be crafted into 1 Stick
- Chorus Fruit can be used in place of generic Wooden Planks, such as for crafting Wooden Tools and Chests
- Purpur Block can be used in place of generic Logs, such as crafting for Campfires and Smokers
- Purpur Slabs can be used in place of generic Wooden Slabs, such as for crafting Barrels or Chiseled Bookshelves

**Note:** Only impacts recipes that use generic logs, generic wooden planks, or generic wooden slabs. This data pack does not allow the crafting of variant specific things such as Boats or Signs.
